name: ArXivMath
intro: ArXivMath 是 MathArena 按月更新的研究级最终答案数学基准。每月约 200 道候选题经筛选与 MathArena 团队最终审核后保留约 30 题；评测并行运行符号解析器与 LLM 裁判，只有解析格式失败才要求模型重述并重试，少于 1% 的判定分歧进入人工复核。
build_method: 月度论文候选生成, 筛选与 MathArena 团队最终审核
metric: 最终答案准确率（4次运行取平均）, 推理成本
eval_feature: 按月动态更新, 研究级数学, 污染缓解, 符号等价判定
scale: 每月约200个候选问题，经筛选后发布约30题
build_method_en: Monthly paper-based candidate generation, screening, and final MathArena-team review
eval_feature_en: Monthly dynamic refresh, research-level mathematics, contamination mitigation, symbolic-equivalence grading
intro_en: ArXivMath is MathArena's monthly research-level final-answer benchmark. Roughly 200 candidates are screened to about 30 problems after final review by the MathArena team; evaluation runs a symbolic parser and LLM judge in parallel, asks for restatement only after a parser formatting failure, and sends the fewer than one percent of decision disagreements to human review.
scale_en: About 200 candidate questions per month, filtered to about 30 released questions
metric_en: Final-answer accuracy averaged over four runs, inference cost
